verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a game engine and editor, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or analytics opt-out for the Unity Editor, Hub, CLI or built players. Community comments say Unity 'phones home', but they describe no opt-out control, so they give no support and no documented claim to dispute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
